purpose: Teach: 光線/皇后/便秘/中越/河口/未婚/南下/右派

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、紫外線光線の皮膚影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you handled UV radiation and its effects on skin in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Leans slightly forward with genuine interest. Steady pace, clear diction. The opening name is a gentle confirmation before the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、皇后陛下の社会活動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the Imperial family's social contributions.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Direct eye contact. Measured pace, no rush. Slight emphasis on the opening affirmation, then steady through the topic shift.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 便秘症の食事療法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed dietary approaches to constipation in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Slight pause before the topic. Observing Sakura's reaction. Tone is curious rather than testing — genuine wonder at the range of subjects.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中越地震の復興を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about reconstruction efforts following the Chuetsu earthquake.
lines.style: Calm, grounded. The opening affirmation is definite. Slightly deliberate pacing, like she's been prepared to defend these choices. Steady through to the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 河口域の生態系を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored estuarine ecosystems in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged, slightly more animated than before. Leans in with real interest. Warm smile in the voice. The observation comes with genuine curiosity about where this is going.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、未婚率の長期動向を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about long-term trends in unmarried rates.
lines.style: Grounded, undefensive. The affirmation is solid. Slight steadiness in her tone — these answers are different from what was asked, and she's aware of it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 寒気団の南下と健康影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the southward movement of cold air masses and their health impacts in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, gently probing. Slower pace on the topic itself. There's a sense of piecing something together in real time. The final question mark carries weight — Asuka is beginning to notice the pattern.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、欧州右派政党の動向を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about trends in European right-wing political parties.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. The affirmation is direct. Pace remains even throughout, neither rushed nor defensive. She's clearly aware of the mismatch now, and she's holding the line.
